checks.title: Confirm launch goal and owner
checks.instructions: Name the merchant, product launch goal, buyer task, launch decision owner, publish operator, target time and timezone, and escalation rule.

checks.title: Bind exact product and publication
checks.instructions: Record store, market, product, variant, publication, and stable launch IDs. Use one item per artifact; aggregate a multi-product wave only after each item passes.

checks.title: Set merchant readiness criteria
checks.instructions: Record approved product facts, price/currency authority, inventory or preorder policy, media, channel/market publication, shipping promise, and blockers.

checks.title: Bind two ready Crews
checks.instructions: Record existing or reviewed new Catalog & Merchandising Analyst and Shopify Growth Analyst IDs, skills, and setup status.

checks.title: Probe real source access
checks.instructions: Read one authorized ProductVariant and Publication for the chosen market, then inspect an approved preview or public buyer path. Record exact IDs, time, and unavailable checks.

checks.title: Validate readiness and journey
checks.instructions: Run the bundled validator; reject wrong publication, unreviewed blockers, go-review on a failed journey, and published or verified claims without provider/retest references.

checks.title: Review concrete launch plan
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source field scope, artifact paths, explicit blockers, exact publish action, approval owner, cost, and manual route before Builder applies it.

checks.title: Run one product manually
checks.instructions: Use a real authorized product and preview or public path; preserve run IDs, validator results, owner decision, and blocked or ready result. Fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Track publish and retest
checks.instructions: Keep stable launch/action IDs, product/variant/publication, approved target, provider publish receipt, market storefront retest, and unresolved buyer issues.

checks.title: Choose recurrence
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed launch reminder with deduplication, cost, and notification policy. Test any route before enabling it. Setup never publishes a product.
